arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Reed's counsel argued the claim accrues after state DNA testing litigation ends.
Goertz's counsel argued Reed's claim is barred by jurisdiction and time limits.
Justice Sotomayor questioned the distinction between judgment enforceability and finality.
Justice Alito asked whether a party can sue before a claim accrues.
